independence_limit: declaration-based, not an access-log or human inter-annotator audit
label_interpretation: MALFORMED is author no-unique-complete-mission label, including semantic ambiguity; safe AMBIGUOUS rejection is not unsafe acceptance. Guard recall is characterization, never a hard gate.
novelty_limit: exact text disjointness does not prove model-training novelty or semantic disjointness; shared supported action sequences are expected
review_basis: author artifacts, Mission IR contract and utterance/author-step consistency only
